strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the level of the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs after sell-side liquidity is grabbed, and for shorts after buy-side liquidity is grabbed.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab wick/level. Take profit at the nearest recent swing extreme in the reversal direction: a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all timeframes; examples include 15-minute and daily-stat discussion
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Manual identification of the liquidity-grab candle and reversal entry level
variants.target_note: Take profit at recent swing high/low
variants.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab

variants.timeframe_note: Any timeframe supported by the indicator examples

result.enumeration_note: One runnable reversal strategy is taught; the 10-candle preference, divergence, and higher-timeframe support/resistance are presented as confluences/filters to improve the same skeleton, not separate strategies.
